newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold closes slightly weaker, volume dives.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold closes slightly weaker, volume dives.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange shrank to 850 kg on Monday, from 2,765 kg on Friday when banks engaged heavily in arbitrage trade, dealers said.
They said today's trade was dominated by physical demand.
Gold closed slightly firmer at $325.50 an ounce and 1,693,500 per gram, compared to $325.40 and 1,689,000 lira on Friday, following world trends.
The Turkish lira closed sharply weaker at 161,980 to the dollar versus the previous close of 160,290 due to a strong dollar in international markets.
Most of the day's trade -- 495 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 76.5 percent conducted in lira terms.
